newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO, LISCO ADVISOR SHORT-LISTS WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO, LISCO ADVISOR SHORT-LISTS WEDNESDAY.

text.p: Short-lists for government advisers to the privatisation of Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) and Klaipeda Stevedoring Company (KLASCO) will be decided tomorrow, a privatisation official said on Tuesday.

"This week we will send out the terms of reference for these advisers to elaborate their technical and financial proposals," Alfredas Ramanauskas, deputy director of the privatisation department at the European Affairs Ministry, told Reuters.
Ramanauskas said the deadline for responses by those short listed would be in the second half of August.

The European Affairs ministry said earlier that 19 companies had expressed an interest in acting as adviser in the KLASCO privatisation, while 21 were interested in acting as adviser in the LISCO sale.
